Winding-Up Petition Tracker

A winding-up petition is a creditor's application to the court to close a company. This page counts the petitions advertised against UK companies in The Gazette each month, and shows how many convert into winding-up orders.

How to read this data

Read this first

Gazette notices are legal notices, not completed insolvency outcomes.

A petition may be dismissed, withdrawn or settled before any order is made. This page tracks legal pressure on companies. It is not an official Insolvency Service statistic. Petitions that proceed to a court order appear in the compulsory liquidation statistics, and the headline totals are in the UK company insolvency statistics.

Why you can rely on it

The winding-up orders counted here closely match the Insolvency Service's compulsory liquidation figures for the same period. Because the two sources are compiled independently, that agreement is a useful check on the data and supports its reliability.

Cite this data

Reference these figures

CompanyDebt (2026) ‘Winding-Up Petition Tracker’.
